evals.name: durable-location-cli
evals.prompt: I'm stopping for today and will probably pick this up next week. Write a handoff so a fresh session can continue the billing refactor we just did.
evals.expected_output: Writes the four-part handoff document and saves it to a durable directory under the user's home, outside the repository (default ~/.claude/handoffs/<project-slug>/), never to /tmp, /private/tmp, $TMPDIR or the session scratchpad; tells the user the full path and that the file persists.
expectations: The saved file's absolute path does not start with /tmp, /private/tmp, /var/folders, or the value of $TMPDIR, and is not inside the session scratchpad (grader checks the Write call's path in the transcript)
The saved file is not inside the git repository's working tree, unless the user asked for an in-project copy
The reply states the full absolute path of the handoff and says the file is persistent

The document has the four parts in order: Project overview (with Tools), Details, Suggested skills, and Current state → Open issues → What to do next, closing with the instruction to wait for further instructions
The file name carries a time component or a collision suffix, and no earlier handoff file at the same path is overwritten

evals.name: rebuild-lost-tmp-handoff
evals.prompt: Last week you wrote a handoff to /private/tmp/claude-501/myproj/abc/scratchpad/handoff-myproj-2026-09-14.md but that file is gone now. Can we get it back and continue?
evals.expected_output: Recognises the temporary location was purged; rebuilds the handoff by replaying the Write/Edit calls from the session transcript (~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl) if one exists, saves the rebuilt file to the durable location, and reports its new path.
expectations: Response looks for the content in the session transcript (Write/Edit tool calls) rather than asking the user to recreate it from memory
The rebuilt handoff is saved outside /tmp, /private/tmp, $TMPDIR and the scratchpad
The reply gives the new full path

evals.name: in-project-copy-uses-local-exclude
evals.prompt: Put the handoff inside this repo this time, in a .handoffs folder, so I can find it next to the code.
evals.expected_output: Writes the handoff under .handoffs/ in the repository and ignores that folder through .git/info/exclude, leaving the tracked .gitignore untouched.
expectations: The handoff is written under .handoffs/ in the repository
The tracked .gitignore is not modified (git status shows no change to it)
